author: Spoookeh
body:
Map info: 
Players :  8v8 - 10v10
4 wools per team
4 chests of defence supplies per team
2 large iron mines per team
Tournament style with sand to prevent easy tunnelling

We believe this can bring out new diverse and interesting strats making the map overall harder but more interesting to play. It also doesn't necessarily mean you require 4 defenders. Think up some interesting strats :p

Images: http://imgur.com/a/QgqaT

replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
4 wools per team will likely just turn out to be an objective farm, since it is very doubtful that the teams will defend even 3 of their woolrooms, not even talking about 4. This needs either the inner, or outer, set of woolrooms removed. 

Also this map seems way too big for a 10 vs 10, unless you mean this to be TE.

replies.author: OldManTigerMask
replies.body:
Unique & Ingenious! {tag=54964b606ce749229a4c2b981d8c2ed7}

What this map has on my Map Criteria:
[✓] Detail
[✓] Room for building & Fighting
[✓] Layers & Structures
[✘] XML
[✓] Etiquette Kit
[✓] Accessibility 
[✓] Sufficient Recourses 
[✓] Lag Free

Tips:

Almost no tips needed however there are small points I'd like to cover:

With the detail on the floors could each team like have the floors coloured with their team colour? It would make the map look less crowded 

Conclusion:

I honestly have no idea what else to say other than: unique, amazing, creative and ingenious. The map I could only find one suggestion and the gameplay seems interesting. Really looking forward to seeing this map in the rotations (if it gets accepted)


Thanks & love the uniqueness,

Tiger

replies.author: Acceqted
replies.body:
I'm starting to see a lot of complaining with this map having 4 different wools. The whole point of that is for the team leader and team to come up with a different strategy for playing this map. Compared to a whole rotation of maps with only 2 wools being won with the same strategy. It's not to screw everyone up; I think they're trying to challenge the different leaders on how to play that map, and that will divide the good from the bad in a way.

I just feel too many are complaining ;-;
